title: Majority Vote
statement:
Use Boyer–Moore voting and verification to find a strict majority in O(n) time and O(1) extra space beyond input storage.

Input
n, then n integers.

Output
Print the value occurring more than n/2 times, or NONE.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Array values have absolute value at most 10⁹.
